Name: Hachio's Cute Hairstyles for Fashion Sense
Author: mushroomhash
Description:
[center]hello! this is my first official fashion sense mod, so if there are any bugs, please let me know!




[i][size=3]did you ever wish that you had more hair for fashion sense? [/size]
[size=4]if so, then this is the mod for you[/size][/i][size=4]! [/size][size=4] ( •̀ ω •́ )✧
[/size]
[size=5]✧✧✧[/size]


[i][size=5][color=#ead1dc]adding 33 new hairstyles to fashion sense, this mod will leave you feeling like a faishionisa![/color]
[/size][/i][i][size=5]
[/size][/i][size=5]✧✧✧[/size]
[b][color=#d5a6bd][size=6]
all the sprites were made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/80071328]hachiio[/url], i just converted it to fashion sense!﻿(yes i did get permission to post it)
[/size][/color][/b]

[size=4]to use, unzip the file and place it into your mods folder! then open stardew valley, use the mirror and then on the hairstyles area, they should pop up![/size]
[size=4]some special hairs are recolorable, but if you want them to look like the way their original color, set the lightness/darkness bar to 100 (the very bottom color bar)[/size]

please go check out the original mod when you have the chance!

[size=5]✧✧✧[/size][size=4]
